metal: the bindless table's MSL shape, verified - the table's runtime arrays are Metal 3 tier-2 argument buffers in the device address space (MslArgumentBuffers + tier 2 + the device address space, only for programs whose layout has the table); sized arrays (the table's capacities) give the argument buffer's members real layouts, and the shared sampler per kind sits at a binding beyond the arrays' id consumption - spirv-cross's unsized arrays alias their members and cannot hold distinct texture and sampler handles

metal: the vertex vocabulary - vertex and index buffers, indexed draws and push constants on the command list; the stages' one binding table per kind flattened (base + set x 8 + binding, in SpirvPatch.RemapBindings before the translation and MetalShaders.Flatten at the runtime binds, so two sets with the same binding number keep apart); the push constants take the stage's top index 30 (this spirv-cross has no option for them, so the MSL's block moves); the native-model programs (MetalShaders.Native, as ShaderLibrary.Native builds them); the host's --tri quad testbed: the four corners' colours and the centre's interpolation land exactly
